summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ALPS Dynamic US Dividend Advantage ETF (RFDA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively-managed fund that invests in US-domiciled companies with higher dividend yields than their peers within the same sector, among other factors. RFDA was launched on Jun 7, 2016 and is issued by SS&C.

holdings.infoBox: RFDA is an equity ETF with a total of 75 individual holdings. The top holdings are Cash Equivalent stock at 5.42%, NVIDIA at 3.42%, Johnson & Johnson at 3.29%, JPMorgan Chase & Co. at 2.98%, and UnitedHealth Group at 2.78%.
